headline: Rays Take the ALCS
caption:
The Tampa Bay Rays win the ALCS, taking down the Cleveland Guardians 4-2.

Our model picked Tampa Bay before the series at 56%, so this was no lock. Cleveland had a real shot. We projected a 4-3 series and the Rays finished it a game early, close but not exact.

That makes our series picks 7 of 9 so far this postseason, hits and misses alike.

Did you see the Rays winning this one, or were you on Cleveland?
